comment: Reviewed record of how this fork differs from upstream. Regenerate with testing-scripts/check_upstream_parity.py --update after auditing, and write a reason for every entry: the checker fails on an empty reason on purpose.

.github/workflows/pull_request.yml.reason: adds the Windows CI jobs and drops the container matrix this fork does not run

.github/workflows/release.yml.reason: adds the Windows bundle job so a release ships a prebuilt web interface

.gitignore.reason: ignores native install artifacts (venv, bundled binaries, native build output)

docker/main/rootfs/usr/local/go2rtc/crea.reason: thin entrypoint into frigate.util.go2rtc_config, which the native install also calls

docs/docs/frigate/installation.md.reason: documents the native Windows install instead of upstream's 'not officially supported' note

frigate/__main__.py.reason: spawn instead of forkserver on Windows, and signal handling that also works in a service

frigate/api/app.py.reason: log and asset paths for the native server; no /dev/shm

frigate/api/camera.py.reason: timeout and error handling around the go2rtc HTTP calls, which can race the native go2rtc start

frigate/api/debug_replay.py.reason: internal listen port of the native server

frigate/api/media.py.reason: concat playlists go through a temp file instead of /dev/stdin

frigate/app.py.reason: native lifecycle: no s6 supervision, Windows signal and service handling, uvicorn started in process

frigate/camera/maintainer.py.reason: shared-memory sizing and cleanup through the platform layer; there is no /dev/shm

frigate/comms/config_updater.py.reason: ipc_endpoint() and a close helper that tolerates an already-closed context

frigate/comms/inter_process.py.reason: ipc_endpoint() and shutdown that closes sockets in order

frigate/config/camera/camera.py.reason: rejects Windows reserved device names as camera names

frigate/config/camera/ffmpeg.py.reason: Windows hwaccel preset validation and input argument checks

frigate/config/camera/record.py.reason: recording path handling for Windows volumes

frigate/config/config.py.reason: Windows first-run defaults: no openvino detector and no /media/frigate assumptions

frigate/const.py.reason: paths resolve through frigate.util.platform: the container layout on Linux, one base directory on Windows

frigate/db/sqlitevecq.py.reason: loads sqlite-vec from the Windows wheel layout

frigate/detectors/detector_config.py.reason: the default labelmap comes from the platform layer

frigate/detectors/detector_types.py.reason: reports the real import error for a detector runtime that is not installed

frigate/detectors/device.py.reason: names the detector runtimes Windows can run when a device string names a Linux-only one

frigate/detectors/hardware.py.reason: hardware probes read Windows driver APIs instead of DRM and proc entries

frigate/ffmpeg_presets.py.reason: Windows encode and decode presets (nvenc, qsv, d3d11va, dxva2, amf)

frigate/jobs/motion_search.py.reason: internal port for VOD requests on the native server

frigate/log.py.reason: no os.register_at_fork on Windows; std streams are reopened for spawn

frigate/output/birdseye.py.reason: writes frames to the birdseye named pipe instead of creating one with os.mkfifo

frigate/output/camera.py.reason: process stop path for Windows, which has no SIGKILL semantics

frigate/output/output.py.reason: shared-memory cleanup and dropping cached camera mappings on Windows

frigate/output/preview.py.reason: concat playlist through a temp file and cache cleanup through robust_remove

frigate/record/export.py.reason: export paths, ffmpeg resolution and concat input for Windows

frigate/record/maintainer.py.reason: robust_remove/robust_move so a scanner holding a file does not fail retention

frigate/service_manager/multiprocessing..reason: supervises children with spawn and Windows process handling instead of signal restarts

frigate/stats/emitter.py.reason: shared-memory statistics and notices keyed by the platform's storage key

frigate/stats/hardware.py.reason: no device-node existence check on Windows; the prober reports only hardware the driver drives

frigate/stats/util.py.reason: storage statistics use platform.storage_stat_key() instead of /dev/shm

frigate/test/test_config.py.reason: documents the Windows config behaviours (reserved names, case collisions)

frigate/test/test_detector_device.py.reason: expects the Windows detector list in the error message

frigate/test/test_detector_hardware.py.reason: expectations for the Windows hardware prober

frigate/test/test_ffmpeg_presets.py.reason: expectations for the Windows preset families

frigate/test/test_ffmpeg_progress.py.reason: low priority is a Windows process priority class, not nice

frigate/test/test_file.py.reason: msvcrt file locking instead of fcntl

frigate/test/test_mqtt_network_loop.py.reason: fcntl and resource are not available on Windows

frigate/test/test_restart_frigate.py.reason: restart through the launcher and service instead of exec

frigate/test/test_shared_memory_frame_ma.reason: page-aligned mappings and the Windows segment size rule

frigate/test/test_shm_notice.py.reason: page-file backed shared memory has no size to raise

frigate/util/audio.py.reason: concat playlist through a temp file

frigate/util/builtin.py.reason: command splitting goes through the platform layer's Windows-aware splitter

frigate/util/classification.py.reason: ffmpeg and ffprobe paths resolve through the platform layer

frigate/util/config.py.reason: resolve_ffmpeg_path falls back to PATH on a native install; no /dev/shm in the runtime-writable list

frigate/util/env.py.reason: reads the secrets file as explicit utf-8

frigate/util/ffmpeg.py.reason: request_ffmpeg_stop quits ffmpeg cleanly on Windows so the file being written is finalized

frigate/util/file.py.reason: FileLock uses msvcrt on Windows and keeps fcntl on POSIX; robust_remove/robust_move live here

frigate/util/hwaccel.py.reason: Windows hwaccel detection through driver APIs instead of VAAPI and DRM probes

frigate/util/image.py.reason: the frame manager tolerates page-rounded segment sizes and has no resource tracker

frigate/util/media.py.reason: ffprobe resolves through the platform layer

frigate/util/ownership.py.reason: no uid/gid on Windows, so pwd is imported optionally and chown is skipped

frigate/util/process.py.reason: no setproctitle or os.nice on Windows; process groups and job objects instead

frigate/util/services.py.reason: Windows replacements for the /proc, /dev/shm, libva and DRM probes, and for nice

frigate/video/ffmpeg.py.reason: reads exactly one frame from a page-aligned mapping and reports a short read

pyproject.toml.reason: Windows extras (onnxruntime-directml) and the native entry point

web/package.json.reason: adds the native web build script

web/src/types/stats.ts.reason: storage statistics type follows the platform key

web/src/views/system/StorageMetrics.tsx.reason: shows page-file backed shared memory instead of /dev/shm

fork_only_files..github/workflows/upstream_parity.yml: weekly drift check against upstream's branch tip; upstream needs no equivalent
fork_only_files.WINDOWS_COMPATIBILITY.md: this fork's own port audit and Windows documentation; upstream has no equivalent
fork_only_files.bootstrap_windows.py: native Windows installer and launcher; upstream only ships container images
fork_only_files.docker/main/requirements-windows.txt: pip requirements for the native install; upstream's set is container-only
fork_only_files.frigate/api/vod_native.py: video-on-demand for the native server, which has no nginx to serve recordings
fork_only_files.frigate/api/web.py: serves the built web interface from the native server; upstream leaves that to nginx
fork_only_files.frigate/test/test_capture_frames.py: tests for reading one frame out of a page-aligned Windows mapping
fork_only_files.frigate/test/test_config_updater_cleanup: tests for the config updater's ZMQ shutdown path
fork_only_files.frigate/test/test_ffmpeg_stop.py: tests for request_ffmpeg_stop's Windows quit sequence
fork_only_files.frigate/test/test_job_object.py: tests for the job object that keeps child process trees from outliving Frigate
fork_only_files.frigate/test/test_native_e2e.py: end-to-end run of the native server against a synthetic camera
fork_only_files.frigate/test/test_native_web_app.py: tests for the native web app routes that nginx would otherwise front
fork_only_files.frigate/test/test_onnx_directml.py: tests for the DirectML detector configuration
fork_only_files.frigate/test/test_platform_windows.py: tests for platform paths, IPC endpoints and quoting on Windows
fork_only_files.frigate/test/test_sqlitevecq_windows.py: tests for loading sqlite-vec from the Windows wheel layout
tests for the parity checker, against throwaway repositories
fork_only_files.frigate/test/test_windows_hwaccel.py: tests for the Windows hwaccel presets and auto-detection
fork_only_files.frigate/test/test_windows_service.py: tests the service wrapper's interpreter lookup and exit policy, which are plain logic and are checked on every platform (upstream has no SCM service)
fork_only_files.frigate/test/windows_suite_denylist.txt: names the tests that cannot run on Windows for the CI unit-suite job
fork_only_files.frigate/util/birdseye_pipe.py: named-pipe equivalent of upstream's os.mkfifo birdseye pipe
fork_only_files.frigate/util/go2rtc_config.py: go2rtc config generation moved out of the container entrypoint so the native install can run it
fork_only_files.frigate/util/go2rtc_process.py: supervises the bundled go2rtc binary; upstream lets s6 do it
fork_only_files.frigate/util/job_object.py: Windows job objects, so a killed Frigate takes its ffmpeg and go2rtc children with it
fork_only_files.frigate/util/platform.py: the platform layer the port goes through: paths, IPC endpoints, process priority, quoting
fork_only_files.frigate/util/version.py: reads the version from installed metadata when the image-generated frigate/version.py is absent
fork_only_files.frigate/util/windows_service.py: pywin32 service framework so Frigate can run as a Windows service
fork_only_files.scripts/install_frigate_service.ps1: installs, starts, stops and removes the Windows service
fork_only_files.testing-scripts/check_upstream_parity.py: the parity checker itself: it compares this tree against the recorded upstream commit
fork_only_files.testing-scripts/check_windows_requiremen: checks the Windows requirement set and the bundled ffmpeg/go2rtc versions
annotates Windows CI logs with the test failures
fork_only_files.testing-scripts/run_windows_unit_suite.p: runs the whole unit suite on Windows minus the denylist; upstream's CI is Linux containers
fork_only_files.testing-scripts/upstream_parity_baseline: the reviewed record of every deliberate divergence from upstream
fork_only_files.winget-manifest/Frigate.FrigateWindows.y: winget package manifest for the native install (still needs a signed installer URL)
